samples.question: Four letter tiles start in the shown numbered slots. Read the six cards from left to right. One, two, or three purple dots selects slots 1-2, 2-3, or 3-4. The orange arrow points to the side that must hold the alphabetically later tile. Swap the selected tiles only if needed to satisfy that arrow; otherwise do nothing. Which letter finishes in the red-ringed slot? Answer A, B, C, or D.
